title: nixos/dnscrypt-proxy: fix `.settings` type
structural_notes: Diff changes the settings option's type from lib.types.attrs to settingsFormat.type (pkgs.formats.toml{}.type); this is a type-only change on the existing settings mkOption declaration line, so settings is watched alongside baseline enable. Test file changes (extra listen port / deep-merge check) do not touch enable or settings mkOption declaration lines themselves.
